server_access.transfer_scope: Only the first 65,536 bytes were requested and received. The bounded TIFF prefix may contain bytes beyond TIFF metadata depending on file layout; no elevation window or raster values were read or requested. The full raster was not downloaded.

coordinate_sources: NASA Lunar Surface Data Book Revision A, Table A2-2 (site and center values; table does not repeat conventions)
NASA LOLA RDR coordinate documentation (planetocentric/body-fixed, east-positive longitude 0-360, ME reference system)
NASA PGDA Product 78 documentation (Site DEMs in MOON_ME / DE421)

projected_center_m.status: derived from the cited coordinates using the observed spherical south-polar stereographic CRS and the current 1,737,400 m provider sphere; no raster samples were read

raster_metadata.pixel_registration: GeoTIFF AREA_OR_POINT=Area; pixel-center coordinates follow the affine transform.

provider_comparison.current_provider_projection_assumption: South-polar stereographic, latitude of origin -90 degrees, central meridian 0 degrees, zero false easting/northing, spherical radius 1,737,400 m.
provider_comparison.current_provider_coordinate_assumption: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, tagged MOON_ME_DE421 position projected on the 1,737,400 m sphere into the opened raster CRS.
provider_comparison.provider_5m_resolution_handling: The reader uses the opened raster CRS and metadata resolution, but its class name and MAX_WINDOW_SIDE_PX=2048 limit remain relevant; a 10 km radius at 5 m requires over 4,000 pixels across and cannot be read as one provider window.
provider_comparison.coverage_note: The raster extent contains the projected Site07 center, but its nearest axis-aligned edge is about 8 km away. A 10 km circular horizon would exceed the raster extent. Valid elevation sampling and NoData distribution were not tested.

unresolved.band_elevation_units: No band unit was exposed in the bounded metadata read.
unresolved.vertical_reference: No vertical datum/reference was exposed in the bounded metadata read.
unresolved.raster_source_frame: The bounded raster metadata did not encode a named body-fixed frame; MOON_ME_DE421 is supported by the cited PGDA product documentation, not a frame tag observed in the TIFF.
unresolved.scale_offset_encoding: Rasterio reports scale 1 and offset 0, but explicit scale/offset tags were not observed; whether these are driver defaults remains unverified.
unresolved.actual_valid_coverage: No elevation windows were read; raster extent containment does not establish valid samples at the site or across any analysis circle.
unresolved.shared_20m_product_suitability: Not assessed; Product 90 coverage and sampling at Site07 must be checked separately.

limitations: Metadata was parsed from one bounded 65,536-byte prefix only.
The range response may include non-metadata bytes due to TIFF file layout; no raster values were requested or read.
No code, production configuration, existing report, dashboard, or terrain profile was changed or generated.
